heroLead: Guqula uhambo lwakho lokurhweba ngokuziqhelanisa nokubhalwa kweendaba.
accessReady: Ijenali yakho ilungile. Khetha ithebhu ukuze uqalise.
exampleHint: Ithemplethi yenqaku, hayi idatha yeakhawunti yakho.
foundationMarketText: Ukurhweba kuthetha ukuthenga nokuthengisa izixhobo kwimarike. Unikezelo, imfuno, imali yokuhlawula amatyala, kunye neendaba zinefuthe kumaxabiso. Bhala umxholo emva kwesigqibo ngasinye.
foundationRiskText: Yonke indawo inokulahlekelwa yimali. Ubungakanani besikhundla, umgama wokumisa, ukusasazeka, kunye neendleko zentengiselwano zimisela impembelelo yayo kwiakhawunti yakho.
foundationPlanText: Isizathu sokungeniswa, inqanaba lokumisela ukunganyaniseki, kunye nethagethi zezakho kwisicwangciso sakho. Amanqaku akho anceda ukuthelekisa isicwangciso kunye nokuphunyezwa kwangempela.
foundationProbabilityText: Urhwebo olunye aluseki umgangatho wesicwangciso. Phonononga uthotho lwezikhundla, ubungakanani beenzuzo kunye nelahleko, kunye nendlela othe wayilandela rhoqo inkqubo yakho.
purposeTitle: Ijenali ijika amava abe yinto onokuyiphonononga.
purposeBefore: Ngaphambi korhwebo: bhala isizathu, imeko yemarike, kunye nomda womngcipheko.
purposeAfter: Emva korhwebo: rekhoda isiphumo, iimvakalelo, kunye nokuba usilandele na isicwangciso.
purposeReview: Ngexesha lophononongo: chonga iipateni eziphinda-phindayo kwaye ukhethe utshintsho olunye olunokumetwa.
purposeDetail: Ijenali inceda ukuchonga imikhwa yokuphucula. Vavanya inkqubela ngenkqubo yakho kunye nengqokelela yezorhwebo, ngaphandle kwezithembiso zembuyekezo yokurhweba.

loginDescription: Sayina nge-imeyile ukugcina ijenali yakho efini kwaye ufikelele kuyo kwezinye izixhobo.

cloudHint: Iiakhawunti ezintsha zinokufuna ukuqinisekiswa kwe-imeyile. Ijenali yakho izigcina ngokuzenzekelayo kwiseva emva kokungena. Ukungenisa ngaphandle ijenali yeendwendwe kufuna isiqinisekiso sakho.

ui_4261cc1e72bdcb33: Uluhlu lweerhafu luphakamisa iindleko zokungenisa elizweni, kodwa amaxabiso abathengi axhomekeke kwimida, uluhlu lwempahla, ukutshintshwa kwabaxhasi kunye nemfuno. Uphando lwe-New York Fed yomhla we-6 ka-Okthobha luchaza ukudlula ngokuthe ngcembe. Inqanaba lexabiso eliphezulu alithethi ukuba ukunyuka kwamaxabiso aphezulu ngokusisigxina: ukunyuka kwamaxabiso ngonyaka kunokunciphisa xa ukunyuka kokuqala kwehla kuthelekiso.
